name: TCC Summer Camp
description_short: A weekly day camp in Woodstock, VT for ages 5–12. It runs 8am–4pm with optional late care until 5pm. Each week has a theme, such as hiking, plants, birding or unusual sports, and most weeks include field trips.
refund_policy_summary: You must give 30 days' notice to withdraw. If you cancel within 30 days, you still pay in full for the registered days. Cancellations made earlier than that get at most a 50% refund. From May 15, absences are still charged under the 30-day policy. If enrollment is forfeited for unpaid late fees, no refund is given.
